python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/home')
import parse

# Test search behavior
p = parse.Parser('{:<}')
m = p._search_re.search('hello world')
print('search <:', repr(m.group()) if m else 'no match')

# Test findall
result = parse.findall('{:<}', 'hello world')
print('findall <:', [r.fixed for r in result])

# Test with following literal
r = parse.parse('{:<} world', 'hello       world')
print('parse {<} world:', r.fixed if r else None)

# Test right-aligned (should still work)
r = parse.parse('hello {:>}', 'hello       world')
print('parse hello {>}:', r.fixed if r else None)

# Test center
r = parse.parse('hello {:^} world', 'hello  there     world')
print('parse hello {^} world:', r.fixed if r else None)

# Test just left alone
r = parse.parse('{:<}', 'hello world')
print('parse {<} alone:', r.fixed if r else None)

# Test search with center
p2 = parse.Parser('{:^}')
m2 = p2._search_re.search('hello world')
print('search ^:', repr(m2.group()) if m2 else 'no match')
" 2>&1
